capabilities.name: printing.surface
capabilities.description: Physical printing envelope for one material/configuration; no driver or job execution.

max_width.description: Maximum printable width on the configured X axis.

max_height.description: Maximum printable height on the configured Y axis.

max_thickness.description: Maximum object thickness on the configured Z axis.

max_loaded_mass.description: Maximum total mass loaded for this configuration.

max_object_width.description: Maximum width of one object in this configuration.

max_object_length.description: Maximum length of one object in this configuration.

print_mode_id.description: Stable adapter-local identifier of the active print mode.

resolution_x.description: Configured resolution on the X axis.

resolution_y.description: Configured resolution on the Y axis.

ink_channels.description: Available configured ink roles, e.g. cmyk, white, varnish.

material_types.description: Material classes validated for this configuration.
